_comment: Planned, timed road closures that the live feeds do not carry: Traffic Scotland's incident feed is unplanned events only, and the road works register gives dates but not hours. Hand-kept, from the road operator's own published hours. Shown on the Today board and on Roadworks while `starts`..`expires` covers today (currentNotices: build-time, self-expiring, one at a time). The words on the page are always true as written; the reader's browser only changes the badge by the clock (closes at / closed until / closes tomorrow) and turns it red inside the hours. `closeFrom` and `closeTo` are Largs time, HH:MM, and the closure is taken to be every day. `finish` is a whole sentence saying where the end date comes from, for Roadworks; `finishShort` is the same fact as a few words, for the Today board, which carries one short sentence and sends the reader to Roadworks for the rest. Nothing is removed by hand: set `expires` to the last day you are sure of and revisit it.

closures.between: At other times it is open with one lane under temporary lights.
closures.diversion: The signed diversion is by the A760, A737 and A761.
closures.finish: Friday 27 November is the last day of the closures: from 15:00 that day the road is open at all times, still with one lane under temporary lights.
closures.finishShort: for the last time on Friday 27 November
closures.source: Amey’s published hours · not a live reading
